newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Dutch foreign trade minister visits Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Dutch foreign trade minister visits Argentina.

text.p: Dutch Foreign Trade Minister Anneke van Weele de van Dok arrived in Argentina late Wednesday for a two-day visit to promote trade ties between the two countries, the Dutch embassy said Thursday.
The minister will meet with Argentina's Economy Minister Roque Fernandez and Foreign Trade Secretary Jorge Campbell, among others.
She is accompanied by a business delegation including representatives from ABN-AMRO Bank, SHV Makro and Boskalis International NV.
Van Dok is due to travel to Chile afterwards.
